en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2026 - Ali ibn Abi Hamzah narrated from Abu Basir, who narrated from Abu Abdullah (as), who said:

"The Torah was revealed on the sixth of Month of Ramadan, the Injil (Gospel) was revealed on the twelfth of Month of Ramadan, the Zabur (Psalms) was revealed on the eighteenth of Month of Ramadan, and the Quran [Al-Furqan] was revealed on Laylatul Qadr."
